title: Added regression coverage for stale-price ticker exclusions
points: Regression evals can now be filtered with EVAL_CASES for focused production replays.
Added a guard that verifies stale-price symbols such as AASM short-circuit as outside the served priced universe instead of running failing market-data SQL.
Updated schema documentation to distinguish the 471-ticker statement/document corpus from the narrower served ticker reference used for price-dependent answers.
